svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 04 · Irvine · 05/12 The Back Bay (Uncommon)
svg.desc: A wide estuary between the bluffs, mud flats and marsh. Walk the loop at low tide and count egrets. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
